unit.why: A short anecdote: during the author's teacher's visit to R. Shimon of Jaroslaw, R. Shimon wondered aloud that he too had come, and the teacher answered with a pointed verse.
unit.boundary_note: One numbered item in a series of the teacher's visits to tsaddikim, (ג) between (ב) and (ד).

stories.start_quote: בהיותו אצל הרה״ק רבי ר׳ שמעון מיעריסלאב
stories.summary_en: When 'our teacher' visited R. Shimon of Jaroslaw, the tsaddik held him in such esteem that he asked in wonder, 'Have you too come to me?', and the teacher replied that in him the saying 'you shall see your world in your lifetime' was fulfilled.

quotes: בהיותו אצל הרה״ק רבי ר׳ שמעון מיעריסלאב
tags.why: The teacher visits another tsaddik, one of a series of such visits.
